components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact teal action for the one clear commit action in a local toolbar or form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 2rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-body); transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Navigation Button
components.description: Quiet pill navigation that becomes a muted surface only on hover or active route.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { height: 1.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.25rem 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 78%, transparent); text-decoration: none; font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-body); transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-pill:hover, .ds-nav-pill[data-active="true"] { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); }

components.name: Default Input
components.description: Compact field for period, search, and filter inputs.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-body); transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Stable dark surface for dashboard cards, charts, and compact information groups.
components.html:
ANALISE

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.225rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-eyebrow { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 var(--font-body); letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 1.25rem/1.25 var(--font-heading); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.6 var(--font-body); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact metadata marker for coverage, period state, and selected filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; width: fit-content; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 70%, transparent); color: var(--muted-foreground); padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 var(--font-body); letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip[data-tone="brand"] { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Dense ledger-style rows for financial statements and comparable company data.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.45 var(--font-body); } .ds-table thead { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 50%, transparent); } .ds-table th { height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; text-align: left; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 var(--font-body); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table td { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border) 50%, transparent); } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 45%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
CVM Analytics should feel like a focused analyst workstation: dark, precise, local, and trustworthy. The interface serves comparison and verification, so hierarchy, period context, coverage, and state must be clearer than decoration.

The system is restrained by default. Neutral surfaces create the workspace; teal marks action, selection, focus, and high-value signals. Density is allowed because the user is comparing financial data, but every dense region needs clear grouping, legible labels, and enough spacing to avoid a generic dashboard blur.

This system explicitly rejects a dashboard SaaS generico look. It must not drift into promo-fintech polish, neon crypto language, raw spreadsheet UI, or chart spectacle that hides auditability.
keyCharacteristics: Teal accent used for action and current state, never decoration.
Rounded, bordered surfaces with tonal layering instead of heavy shadows.
Visible evidence: periods, data states, filters, and empty/error states are part of the design.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is for action, selection, focus, and signal. If teal appears as background decoration, the screen is losing discipline.

rules.name: The Evidence Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text and chart elements required for understanding must meet practical WCAG AA contrast; muted text can be quiet, but it cannot become decorative noise.

rules.name: The Data First Rule
rules.body: Numbers, labels, and periods must be readable before headings become expressive. Do not use display-scale type inside compact cards or controls.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are stable at rest. Add shadow only when the element is elevated by structure or interaction.

dos: Do keep the product dark, restrained, dense, and audit-focused.
Do use `primary` teal for action, current state, focus, and meaningful signal.
Do show period context, selected filters, data coverage, loading, empty, and error states close to the component they affect.
Do use borders, muted fills, and subtle rings before adding shadow.
Do keep chart legends, labels, and tooltips explicit enough that color is not the only source of meaning.
Do preserve keyboard focus states on filters, dropdowns, calendar controls, tabs, and table actions.
donts: Don't make the interface look like a dashboard SaaS generico.
Don't use neon crypto styling, purple-blue glow defaults, generic fintech landing polish, or raw spreadsheet presentation.
Don't add duplicated filters, nested cards, or decorative chart containers that weaken hierarchy.
Don't use teal as ornamental background texture.
Don't rely on color alone for financial state, chart identity, or warning severity.
Don't introduce side-stripe accent cards, gradient text, glassmorphism as default, or decorative motion.
